wrapper_for_full_pipeline.method: Copy preserved sources and their named source data/template stages into a temporary workspace with the documented relative layout, then execute scripts in the stated sequence. Import-time path constants may instead be assigned by a separate wrapper for main-guarded scripts; top-level audit/render scripts require the workspace layout. Preserve original source files and input versions.
wrapper_for_full_pipeline.not_tested_by_portable_verifier: Full regeneration of old-to-current document images, original author-workspace screenshot matching and pixel-identical figure rendering.
